svg.title: Choose connectivity separately from deployment type
svg.desc: Connected deployments host their control plane in an Azure region, with workloads at the customer site. Agents initiate outbound connections. Disconnected operations host the control plane on a dedicated local three-node production management cluster, separate from business workloads. Hyperconverged deployments support either mode. Disaggregated deployments support either mode. Multi-rack preview deployments support connected mode only. Small form factor preview deployments support connected mode only. An internet outage does not convert a connected deployment into disconnected operations.

svg.text: Choose connectivity separately from deployment type
Arrows show management dependencies. Read each column from top to bottom.
Service availability depends on workload eligibility for the selected release.
An internet outage does not change the deployment mode
Local workloads need healthy dependencies to keep running.
Cloud management can fail; disconnected operations require a planned deployment.
